title: Some uniform estimates for Kähler--Ricci Shrinkers
summary: In this paper, we establish several uniform estimates for Kähler--Ricci shrinkers without imposing any curvature assumptions. In particular, we prove: 1. a uniform lower bound for the entropy; 2. a uniform lower bound for the asymptotic volume ratio of Kähler--shrinkers with maximal volume growth; 3. a uniform lower bound for the scalar curvature on balls centered at a minimum point of the soliton potential for non-Gaussian shrinkers.
